messages:
alex: Heads up — Brightstone Analytics dedicated rollout window proposal. Looking at Thurs 2026-05-14 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary 10% for 30m, then 50% for 20m, full at 03:00 if stable. Need PM + security sign-off. @pm_jordan @maria

maria: That window works for Brightstone (they confirmed offline). Ask: are we pinning model and runtime?

alex: Yes, plan is to pin to `rwd-infer-3.0.1` and model artifact `brightstone-v1.7.0-quant`. Will include fallback route to `rwd-infer-2.x` if errors spike.

devon: Add rollback thresholds: error rate > 1.5% OR p95 latency increase > 40% for 10m triggers auto-rollback to previous flavor. Also keep manual abort option.

alex: noted. Will add to rollout doc. Also enabling token-level tracing for first 2h.

ops-oncall: Reminder — change window falls inside our DB maintenance window in us-east-1 (03:00). Recommend we shift to 02:30-04:30 to avoid conflict or coordinate cross-team.

pm_jordan: Brightstone asks no overlap with their analytics ETL at 02:45. Can we do 01:30-03:30 UTC instead? They prefer earlier.

maria: Earlier is fine for infra, but need oncall coverage. Devon/Eva, can you cover 01:30-03:30?

eva: I can take 01:30-02:45. Devon can cover the rest?

devon: Yep I have 02:45-04:00. Shifted scapegoat. :+1:

alex: Updated timeline: 01:30 UTC start. Canary 10% 01:30-02:00, 50% 02:00-02:30, full at 02:30 if green. Rollback thresholds as Devon specified.

maria: Customer security needs to verify KMS access for private rollout — they said they'll complete approval by Tue noon. Is that blocker?

alex: It's a blocker for Private deployment variant. We can still run Dedicated in the reserved pool if KMS isn't approved, but we must disable bring-your-own-key. Noted in release notes.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Planned rollout created: `rbw/brightstone/2026-05-14/01:30` 
- model: brightstone-v1.7.0-quant
- runtime: rwd-infer-3.0.1
- canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100%
- rollback: error_rate>1.5% OR p95>40%

alex: Quick checklist I posted in the release doc (link): https://internal.redwood/release/brightstone-2026-05-14 — includes operator steps, smoke tests, and rollback playbook.

pm_jordan: I approved the timeline from the customer's side. They want a short release note blurb: "Config pin for inference runtime and faster cold-starts; telemetry enabled for first 2 hours."

maria: Security approval pending but likely. I'll chase. If we don't get KMS OK, we will set `kms=disabled` flag and notify customer.

devon: One more ask — add `--kv-cache-size=2GB` to the dedicated config for this tenant to avoid warm-up token spikes. I tested it in staging.

alex: Added config to rollout spec. Final ask: ops-oncall, can you schedule a pre-rollout readiness ping 30m before start to this channel?

ops-oncall: Yep I'll schedule a ping at 01:00 UTC and will post the health check checklist.

maria: All set from PM side. Once security confirms KMS or accepts flagged path, we can consider this approved. :white_check_mark:

pm_jordan: Confirmed on customer end. Thanks team.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Reminder scheduled: pre-rollout check at 2026-05-14T01:00:00Z in #eng-releases.

alex: Great — tagging for final approvals: @maria @devon @eva please react with :thumbsup: when ok.

(devon reacts with :thumbsup:)

(eva reacts with :thumbsup:)

(maria reacts with :thumbsup:)

alex: Rolling doc locked. Will post final confirmation once security replies.

maria: Security confirmed KMS allowed. This is approved from security side.

alex: Final approval recorded. Ready to proceed on 2026-05-14 01:30 UTC. Thanks everyone! :tada:
